title: Peter's Mother-in-Law Healed
description: After Jesus had been in the synagogue in Capernaum, he went home to Simon Peter and Andrew. Peter's mother-in-law was lying sick with a fever. Jesus went to her, took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
